linkedin_target.connection_instruction: Connect LinkedIn Personal Profile in Metricool web dashboard (https://app.metricool.com/) under Brand ID 6921251

detected_native_mcp_tools.name: getBrandSettings
detected_native_mcp_tools.description: Get the list of brands and connected social networks from your Metricool account.

detected_native_mcp_tools.name: getScheduledPosts
detected_native_mcp_tools.description: Get the list of scheduled posts for a specific Metricool brand (brandId). Only retrieves posts that are scheduled (not yet published).

detected_native_mcp_tools.name: getAnalyticsAvailableMetrics
detected_native_mcp_tools.description: Retrieves the list of available metrics for a specific social network and connector.

detected_native_mcp_tools.name: getAnalyticsDataByMetrics
detected_native_mcp_tools.description: Retrieves analytical data for a specified Metricool account over a given date range, based on a selected list of metrics.

detected_native_mcp_tools.name: getBestTimeToPostByNetwork
detected_native_mcp_tools.description: Get empirical hourly/daily audience engagement distribution for a specific provider (e.g. linkedin) over a 1-week period.

detected_native_mcp_tools.name: createScheduledPost
detected_native_mcp_tools.description: Schedule a new post directly to Metricool at a specific date and time for automatic or push publishing across providers (LinkedIn, X, etc.).

detected_native_mcp_tools.name: createScheduledPostForReview
detected_native_mcp_tools.description: Schedule a NEW post and submit it to Metricool's internal team collaborative review/approval flow.

detected_native_mcp_tools.name: sendScheduledPostForReview
detected_native_mcp_tools.description: Send an ALREADY scheduled post (identified by id and uuid) into Metricool's internal team review/approval flow.

detected_native_mcp_tools.name: updateScheduledPost
detected_native_mcp_tools.description: Update the content, media, or publication timing of an existing scheduled post in Metricool.

publishing_workflow_analysis.distinction: sendScheduledPostForReview operates ONLY on existing, already-scheduled posts (requires id and uuid from getScheduledPosts) to submit them to Metricool's internal team review system. For autonomous agent publishing with our own cryptographic policy gate, the primary execution tool is createScheduledPost with info.autoPublish=true.
